program_overview: Plumbing Technology & National Exam Preparation Program
24-Week Workforce Development, Technical Training & Certification Readiness Program
Tagline: Learn the Code. Master the Trade. Solve the Problem. Pass the Exam.

The Plumbing Technology & National Exam Preparation Program is a comprehensive 24-week career and technical education program designed to introduce students to the knowledge, mathematics, safety procedures, tools, codes, installation practices, troubleshooting techniques, and professional competencies required for entry into the plumbing industry.
The 24-week curriculum is organized into 12 two-week modules.
Students progress through the instructional cycle:
Learn → Observe → Calculate → Practice → Install → Troubleshoot → Assess → Remediate → Master → Certify
